name: Idemcore Receipt Stamp
author: idemcore

sections.description:
Idemcore Receipt Stamp lets you mark AI-assisted content with a signed receipt id so readers can check it themselves.

Add the badge with the [idemcore_receipt] shortcode or the Idemcore Receipt Badge block. The badge shows:

  • The receipt id
  • The model name (optional)
  • The issue time (optional)
  • A Verify receipt link

When you provide a public share id (rshare_ followed by 32 hexadecimal digits), the verify link points to:

https://api.idemcore.net/v1/public/receipts/rshare_…

The plugin does not ship an API key and does not run a model. Checking the signature happens when the reader opens the public share link, or uses the Idemcore browser extension or the open verifier.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the idemcore-receipt-stamp folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Idemcore Receipt Stamp through the Plugins screen.
  3. In a post or page, insert the Idemcore Receipt Badge block, or add the shortcode: [idemcore_receipt id="rcpt_…" share="rshare_…" model="…" issued="…"]
sections.faq:
Does this plugin need an API key?

No. The plugin only displays the receipt id and a verify link that you provide.

What does the share attribute do?

If share is a public share id of the form rshare_ plus 32 hexadecimal digits, the badge links to the public receipt page. You can also set link to a full URL instead.

Does the plugin check the receipt itself?

No. The reader checks the receipt by following the verify link, or by using the Idemcore browser extension or the open verifier.
